testRunner_comment: The command runner reruns Vitest for each mutant. The Vitest plugin reads stale results under Vitest 5 and reports every mutant as survived.

commandRunner.command: pnpm exec vitest run --project unit src/theme/tokens/chart-foreground.test.ts src/intl/date-time-join.test.ts src/components/chart/format src/components/chart/layout

tsconfigFile_comment: TypeScript 7 has no JavaScript API, so Stryker cannot rewrite a tsconfig. The sandbox keeps the package's relative paths, and naming no file skips the step.
mutate_comment: format/chart-strings.ts and layout/errors.ts hold the drafted dictionary and the error prose, which the screen-reader logs and the error tests read, so their string mutants say nothing. The layout/ fixtures are test harnesses.
